note: The authorities the rijal books cite by a one-word name («قال النجاشي», «ذكره الكشي», «قال الشيخ»), and the men they are. They stand in few chains or none, so how often the chains name a man cannot tell a reader who types «النجاشي» or «الكشي» that he means the author of the Rijal and not his ancestor or another man of the same nisba; how often the books cite him can. index_people.py counts the citations in the entries it serves (cited_count); the names are set by hand, checked 2026-11-10.
